testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.DataManagementApiTests

testcase.name: update changes name, config and status and each change is a new version()
the tenant and workspace of a new data source come from the path, never from the body()
another tenant cannot read, update or delete it either()
create, list, get and the safe shape of a data source()
a data source that an application still uses cannot be deleted until it is unbound()
a binding refuses a bad mode, a bad slot, a bad body and any data source that is not this workspace's()
workspace B of the same tenant cannot see or change what workspace A registered, and cannot tell it exists()
without DATA_SOURCE_MANAGE or VIEW every route is a 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, strangers get 404 and anonymous callers are refused()
creation is validated - strict body, unique name, supported type, no secrets in the configuration()
the connector catalogue lists available and planned types with key names only()
changing a binding needs DATA_SOURCE_MANAGE, reading needs DATA_SOURCE_VIEW, and other workspaces' projects do not exist()
configure, replace and remove a credential()
delete removes the data source with its operations and its credential()
test connection runs the connector with the stored credential and answers ok with a latency()
a credential is write only - the answers carry metadata and never a secret()
TEST and LIVE are bound, listed, re-pointed and removed independently()
